steps.content: Rookie, I've heard that you've been gathering info on Mania, Corruptors, and DisSea. I believe you've already noticed the truth is related to your past. Your intelligence work seems to have met a bottleneck, which is normal, since some things are not accessible to you yet. I'll give you a little hint though: Go ask the Sinner you've recently detained. NOX, the living person closest to the truth of DisSea. Good luck, rookie.

steps.speaker: NOX
steps.content: The end is still far away from you... Do you need saving too?
Saving? No one needs your saving here.
Just as you enter the interrogation room and sit down facing NOX, she throws out a somewhat strange question.
This is an interrogation, Sinner NOX. I ask, you answer. This is your duty.
NOX does not respond. You've expected this.

Based on your past interrogation experience, this guarantees a tough interrogation, especially when interacting with this kind of Sinner, who's unresponsive with a fractured mind, but extremely powerful and aggressive.
But this is no excuse to back down. You open the file on the desk—It's the best starting point for this interrogation.
test
test
test
test
test
test
NOX shows no response to what you're doing, not even sparing a peek at the documents on the desk.
Do you know about the Sinner Grim Reaper?
NOX's pale pupils remain lightless.
The Ghost of DisSea, Night Terror, Calamity Witch... You must have at least heard of one of these?
These figures from urban legends, or should I say, horror stories, have been around for almost thirty years. Do you really have no idea at all?
Your victims must have said something with their last breath, no?

steps.speaker: NOX
steps.content: ...You want to hear it?
I need to know.
Dark gray mist pours out from NOX's body. The interrogation room is suddenly filled with many desperate, throaty cries.
Stay away.
Don't kill me.
Kill her!
Kill me...
Several seconds later, the wails surrounding your ears subside. Cold sweat has wetted the back of your shirt.
Your anxiety isn't only caused by your fear of NOX's mysterious ability, but also mostly induced by the unignorable fear and despair in those cries.
Can I interpret that as you're admitting you're indeed the Sinner Grim Reaper?

steps.speaker: NOX
steps.content: I've never called myself that, but...

steps.speaker: NOX
steps.content: ...I like that name.
NOX doesn't deny her identity as the Sinner Grim Reaper.
Since N.F. 84, the authorities have received in total 639 sighting reports of the Grim Reaper. Among them, 511 cases are free of injury records and 27 cases have been closed.
The culprits for the remaining 101 cases are still unidentified. Were all these unsolved cases...
Your doing?
NOX's hollow eyes resemble an unperturbed lake surface. With her mental state, it may be a bit difficult to understand the concept of a case.
The victims come from everywhere in Syndicate and Eastside, including regular civilians, merchants, gangsters, and even FAC officers.
Let me help you recall: the Red Falcon's former leader Usman, Eastside energy business owner Rovi Dante, the FAC's Task Force member Dustin Hertz...

steps.speaker: NOX
steps.content: Names are meaningless.
NOX interrupts you.
If you didn't even know their identities, what was your motive?

steps.speaker: NOX
steps.content: Because I heard the voices in their hearts. I heard the calls...

steps.speaker: NOX
steps.content: They wanted to survive.
What NOX just said somehow stirs up anger and anxiety within you.
You killed them because they wanted to survive?!

steps.speaker: NOX
steps.content: I was saving them.

steps.speaker: NOX
steps.content: The barrier has to be removed, in order to resist the summoning of DisSea.
Without passion, without obsession, NOX says that in an icy tone.
It's exactly because you've studied NOX's Sinner ability, what she's saying now sounds even more twisted and eerie.
test
test
test
test
test
test
test
You still remember clearly the conclusion of the report:

...The assessment report from the Research Institute has validated our hypothesis: the subject's body simultaneously shows multiple traits of Sinners and Corruptors...
...
We are unable to accurately describe her Sinner ability. But one thing is certain: Through a particular means, the subject can rob a dying person of their vitality in the form of an abstract idea and transform it into the foundation of her own existence. Current theories cannot explain the mechanism of this ability.
...
Based on existing information, the subject severely undermines safety and poses potential threats, therefore it is not recommended to use her in battles at this stage.
"Through a particular means, the subject can rob a dying person of their vitality in the form of an abstract idea and transform it into the foundation of her own existence..."
Saving is only a lie.
In essence, your ability is to rob others of their lives.
NOX falls silent for a while.

steps.speaker: NOX
steps.content: Individual souls are too feeble. The only way is to cling onto... us.

steps.speaker: NOX
steps.content: The craving for life and the resistance to death... Our collective will.
Us? She refers to herself as us?
Insane assumptions have occupied your mind. What if NOX is not one person, but a group of people...

steps.speaker: NOX
steps.content: But this is wrong... I...
While you're absorbed in analyzing the situation in your mind, NOX's state is showing significant changes.
She's mumbling to herself, struggle and confusion flicker in her eyes.

steps.speaker: NOX
steps.content: This is the only way to evade death... It's also... our promise...
The slight resistance vanishes quickly and completely, and the cruel icy stare is locked on you once again.

steps.speaker: NOX
steps.content: You are... Very dangerous.

steps.speaker: NOX
steps.content: We, must save you!
Heaps of dark gray mist flow out of NOX's body. Instinctively, you sense danger.
You immediately stand up and apply the shackles. A power strong enough to subdue any Sinner coming from the depths of your mind surges toward NOX.
But the moment it touches NOX, those terrifying wails once again ring in your ears, pierce through your ear drums, and reach directly into your consciousness...
I don't want to die!
Help me!
I don't want to become like that...
Mon... ster...
You stand in the center of a large factory with a fractured left leg, surrounded by corpses. The broken tibia has ripped open the skin, yet you can't feel any pain at all.
You don't know why you're in the middle of an escape in this place. Like muscle memory, those words surge to your throat, and you say them like fulfilling a duty.
Kill those damned traitors... Kill them...
Kill everyone in sight...
Intense cough interrupts your mumbling. Coagulated blood clots fall onto the ground. The air is filled with a pungent rusty smell.
The club belongs to me...
Don't you dare take it away from me!
The bloodshot conjunctiva colors your vision red, but you still see the useless leg being wrapped by a layer of wriggling black silt.
The entire left leg gets covered rapidly.
Facing this unsettling sight, the previous thirst for blood and vengeful desire are overwhelmed by fear.
No! No! Don't come near! I don't want to die!
Get off me!
You stab the dagger hard into your left leg, trying your best to scrape off that damned silt. But it's engulfed the knife-holding hand, slithers along the arm, and charges at you.
Back off! Back off!
I don't want to die...
Somebody help me...
As if answering your plea, a shadow emerges in the dark. She's looking at you, but at the same time seems like she's looking at something else.
No, I don't belong here... Are you here to take me away? Or...
Swish—
In place of her answer, you hear the sound of a sharp weapon slicing through a body.
Your vision tilts gradually. Everything in your sight is spinning.
When you come back to consciousness, the shadow has already disappeared. You hear the wind and your own heavy breaths—You find yourself running in a dark alley.
Damn it, damn it! Where are the sheriffs?
Where are those idiots when you need them?

Lacking regular training, your body finally reaches its limit. You lean against a lamppost and support your chest with your right arm in a cast. You bend down and gasp for air, your heart almost leaping out of your chest.
You decide to stop running. There's gotta be a way to deal with this.
The cast on your right arm hides your secret weapon, the gift given to you by that guy dressed in gray two years ago.

You've made it through several assassination and revenge attempts with it. Be it perfectly equipped assassins or Sinners with mysterious powers, there hasn't been one person who could survive after being hit by it.

<size=32>It does come with a strange side effect though—ever since a certain assassination attempt, it's fused with the nerves of your right arm, undetachable no matter how hard you try. But now as you're gripping it, the pounding of your heart is gradually slowing down.</size>
Only in times like this, I'll be glad I still have this thing with me...
I'm not gonna die here. This time tomorrow, I'll still be a rising star in Eastside's business scene. No one can drag me down!
From under a street light not far away, a lanky shadow spreads to your feet.
Here you are...
Simon paid you to kill me, didn't he?
The shadow approaches step by step without responding.
Whatever sum that pauper offered you, I'll pay you ten times more.
Whether it's power or status, as long as you can name it, there's nothing I can't buy.
The shadow is still silent. The face as pale as that of a corpse is gradually exposed under the dim street light.
Wait! I have an agreement with the Reagan family. You can't kill me...
You feign fear as you back away, discreetly aiming the cast on your right arm at her.
Die!
Twelve dark red light beams pour onto the woman in front of you.
You have to admit that, although it's the worst to have to do it yourself, you still feel extremely relieved as you're pulling the trigger.

You've already thought up a plan to deal with the aftermath in your head—call the esteemed councilor to explain the situation and ask him to take care of it for you. It's only a matter of money, anyway.
Then you'll go home and take a hot shower. It'll be all over.
The dark red light is sliced up by a weirdly shaped weapon. The woman before you is completely unharmed and continues to walk toward you.

You pull the trigger in vain, and nothing comes out of the barrel anymore. You want to run for your life, but that weapon seems to have drained all your strength. Legs going limp, you kneel on the ground.
Puff!
The right arm wrapped in the cast flies up high. At that moment, for some reason, you suddenly feel relieved.
At least, finally gotten rid of it...
You feel a sharpness piercing into your chest, and something warm is drawn out of your body.
Everything before you is gradually becoming corrupted by darkness. You can't see anything, but can only feel your consciousness being dragged, heading toward the next icy death.
The cold you're feeling slowly fades away.
It's already December. Why? Did Mom pay the heating bill without telling me?
But you're still starving.
How strange, where did Mom go?
Mom!
You shout loudly. No one answers you in the pitch-black house. Mom must have gone out.
So hungry.
Tortured by intolerable hunger, you start pacing aimlessly in the house.
In the dark, you smell an aroma from the kitchen.
That's right, Mom left me something to eat in the kitchen.
You rush into the kitchen hurriedly, stuffing your mouth with the food on the floor.
Flesh mixed with fat slides down your esophagus, into your stomach, yet you don't feel satisfied at all. For no particular reason, you suddenly feel sad.
Mom... Sob... Mom...
You're crying, but your hands and mouth do not stop.
Before you notice, a woman is already standing in front of you.
Mom...?
Are you here to... pick me up...?
I'm all alone... I'm scared...
I don't want to... turn into that...
No... No, this is not me!
You scrape inside your own throat desperately, trying to fish out everything you've just swallowed.
How can I be eating this! It's... They're contaminated... contaminated...
But even though you've reached all your hand into your throat, you still don't get any abnormal feelings.
You grab the kitchen knife on the side and cut open your stomach with all your strength...
But only viscous black silt wriggling and turning into monsters... Corruptors.
...Corruptors!
The moment you recall this, a sharp pain shoots up your skull, impaling your spirit like a dagger.
This is all an illusion... I... I've come here to...!
You're walking by a lakeside that seems to extend infinitely. As the humid wind blows in your face, the intense headache surprisingly makes your mind unusually clear.
You're ${PlayerName}, the MBCC's Chief. You've been interrogating the Sinner NOX, and she attacked you...
You're very likely to be inside an illusory space constructed by her spirit—shadows are lurking everywhere around you, letting out meaningless moans.
I don't want to die...
I must live...
Why only me...
That's not enough...
I need more...
You realize the surrounding shadows have noticed your existence.
A healthy soul.
He's not one of us...
I want him...
Sensing danger, you endure the headache and the chaotic thoughts in your head and begin running desperately. You enter a building to evade the shadows' attack.
Following a strange sense, you and the shadows circle each other for a long while, and finally you hide into a ward.
Weirdly enough, here in this place, the headache and the feeling of chaos you were having have all vanished.
On the bed, a young girl dressed in white is staring out the window at the red moon and mumbling to herself.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: Will there be sunshine tomorrow...
With a slender and frail figure, the girl has pale blonde long hair. A starkly different presence from the crowd of shadows out there, she seems like a misfit in this somber, twisted world.
You have a premonition that she knows the way out of here.
Excuse me, do you know...
You walk toward the girl's bed. Hearing your voice, the girl turns back, indigo eyes looking particularly bright.
But the moment she looks at you, the shadows' roars stream in from outside.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: Are you here to visit me?

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: But they don't seem to welcome you...
Countless black shadows tear down the ward's room and swarm toward you, dragging your body until darkness devours you.
The lights in the interrogation room have driven out darkness. You lean against the back of your seat, feeling an inexplicable exhaustion.
Before you realize it, a full team of armed operatives has surrounded you. Leading the team, Nightingale is looking glum.
NOX has already been taken away. Having noticed you've woken up, Nightingale's expression grows softer.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, you passed out just now.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The Sinner NOX attacked you. We must take some measures...
You shake your head wearily.
I'm fine.
I think, I've already found out how to crack this problem.
